title: Notifications
subtitle: Choose which emails you get about {business}. These settings are yours; your teammates choose their own.

negativeAlerts.label: Unhappy customer alerts
negativeAlerts.hint: An email as soon as a customer gives a low rating (1 or 2 out of 5), with their comment and a link to follow up.

weeklyReport.label: Weekly report
weeklyReport.hint: Every Sunday morning: last week's responses, satisfaction and NPS against the week before, your best and weakest branch, and the AI summary.
